root_cause: Historically generated blog Brain, change and ledger files had previously been committed into public PRs and, on 25 October, public main. The canonical publisher allowlist alone was not a global Git staging guard.
fix: Use exact .gitignore patterns for dated private blog Brain/change/ledger files and require existing canonical contract tests to verify the ignore patterns and absence of these private files in the current public source tree.
prevention_rule: The public repository must not contain dated blog Brain/change/ledger evidence; stage only approved public blog HTML and translations. No private content in public Git. Retain service-only approved exporter and the same canonical publisher.
terminal_rule: Exact final SHA Required/BRAIN/CodeQL, protected merge, latest main-tree readback. No claim of deleting historic public GitHub PR cached copies.
